intro: Jaguero Isle is an isolated, jungle-covered island resting off the eastern coast of Stranglethorn Vale's Wild Shore. Dominated by fierce wild panthers and gorillas, it is infamous as the domain of the colossal silverback gorilla known as King Mukla.

p: Situated off the southeastern coast of Stranglethorn Vale, Jaguero Isle stands well apart from the mainland pirate camps and troll ruins. The island is entirely overrun by untamed fauna, mainly panthers and aggressive gorillas. Looming over them all is the gargantuan ape King Mukla, whose rule over the rocky interior is absolute and territorial. Few sailors willingly approach its reefs, though occasionally washed-up bottles along the mainland beaches carry desperate pleas for rescue from those unfortunate enough to be stranded ashore.
